value: Udalo left only a single word, Ata’mal, on the floor. Akama reads it as the next place to seek. No fuller prophecy survives in the available quest record, and this fragment cannot bear more certainty than it contains. A name passes from the prison into the valley’s old temple terraces; the slender clue is enough to move the story, but not enough to reveal what waits there.
